```python
def ref_eval(expr, w):  # semantic
    op = expr["op"]
    if op == "true": return True
    if op == "false": return False
    if op == "match": return list(w) == list(expr["path"])
    if op == "startswith": return startswith(w, expr["path"])
    if op == "endswith": return endswith(w, expr["path"])
    if op == "contains": return contains(w, expr["path"])
    if op == "not": return not ref_eval(expr["arg"], w)
    if op == "and": return all(ref_eval(a,w) for a in expr["args"])
    if op == "or": return any(ref_eval(a,w) for a in expr["args"])

def ref_accept(rules, w):
    allow = any(r["action"]=="allow" and ref_eval(r["when"], w) for r in rules)
    drop = any(r["action"]=="drop" and ref_eval(r["when"], w) for r in rules)
    return allow and not drop
```
